events.title: Verdant Requiem Steam Store Page Is Now Live
events.summary: The Steam store page for Verdant Requiem is now live.Verdant Requiem is a long-form, story-driven tactical RPG set on the continent of Gleria, where the ambitions and ideals of three nations intertwine.Players will not only fight to win battles, but also face the challenges of managing supplies and maintaining the balance between nations.
